description: Source code for a socket connection BIO implementation in OpenSSL, including connection management, socket setup, and I/O operations.

classes.name: BIO_CONNECT
classes.description: Structure representing the state of a connect BIO, including hostname, port, socket info, and callback.

methods.name: split_host_and_port
methods.description: Parses hostname and port from a string, handling IPv6 bracketed addresses.

methods.name: conn_state
methods.description: Manages the connection state machine, handling socket creation, connection, and retries.

methods.name: BIO_CONNECT_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new BIO_CONNECT structure.

methods.name: BIO_CONNECT_free
methods.description: Frees a BIO_CONNECT structure and its associated resources.

methods.name: conn_new
methods.description: Initializes a new connect BIO object.

methods.name: conn_close_socket
methods.description: Closes the socket associated with the BIO.

methods.name: conn_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the connect BIO.

methods.name: conn_ctrl
methods.description: Handles control commands for the BIO, such as setting hostname, port, and non-blocking mode.

methods.name: conn_callback_ctrl
methods.description: Sets callback functions for connection events.

methods.name: BIO_new_connect
methods.description: Creates a new connect BIO with specified hostname.
